facts.text: The user wants to install a CLI on a Linux box with a full Keycloak server.
The user corrected that they are taking without the Keycloak server, just the CLI.
The user wants to use a standalone kcadm.sh extracted from a zip and make it work properly.
The user wants one-liner Linux commands to extract kcadm.sh into /use/local/bin.
The user believes the Keycloak zip file is now in the Keycloak GitHub repository.
The user asks whether kcadm.sh version 15.0.2 can work with a higher version Keycloak server.
